tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje klu sgrub lugs kyi bsnyen pa'i kha skong gi sbyin sreg gsang gsum ye shes me 'od ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī gu h+ya sa mā dza maṇ+ḍal bh+yaḥ rgyal ba'i gsang gsum gcig 'dus ye shes mes/ /ma rig mun sel grub gnyis dge legs kyis/ /snang ba gsal mdzad bla ma'i zhabs btud nas/ /sbyin sreg cho ga'i lag len bshad kyis nyon/ /'dir dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs mi bskyod rdo rje'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i 'phrin las rgya mtsho las/ zhi rgyas gnyis kyi sbyin sreg la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi sbyor bar/ dben pa'i gnas su sa chog ma byas na dkyil chog bzhin dang / byas na mi dgos pas/ ba byung dang dri bzang gis byugs pa'i gzhi la tshangs zur gyi thig btab ste/ zhi rgyas gang rung gi thab khung gi phyir lha snam shin tu che ba'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs nas me ris kyi bar spyi 'gre bzhin bris pa'i thab kyi dbus sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte ba dang thab kyi kha khyer la/ zhi ba ltar na 'khor lo dang 'khor lo'i phreng ba/ rgyas par rin chen dang rin phreng / phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la rdo rje rin chen pad+ma ral gri/ thab khung gi grwa bzhir zhi rgyas kyi khyad/ zla phyed rdo rje'am/ zla phyed rin chen bri bar gsung zhing / de nas bud shing rdzas dang mchod pa yo byad rnams gsung la/ dngos gzhi la dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang 'brel ba dang / ma 'brel ba'i lugs gnyis las/ 'brel ba ltar na sngon 'gro gtor ma nas phyi rol gtor ma grub nas nang du log te lhag chad kha bskong / gsol btab sgo dbye/ bzod gsol rnams grub pa dang / zhi rgyas gang rung gi sbyin sreg la zhugs nas/ 'das pa'i me lha spyan 'dren gyi tshe rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams thab nang du me tog gis mtshan pas spyan drangs te zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg gang rung 'bul bar gsung /

ma 'brel ba ltar na bdag bskyed skyabs 'gro nas nyer bsdu'i bar byas la/ sbyin sreg gi bsrung 'khor nas bzung cho ga rnams bya bar gsungs shing / 'das pa'i me lha'i gtso bo zhi rgyas kyi khyad rnam snang dang rin 'byung gang rung go 'pho bar gsungs shing / dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ma 'brel gang ltar na'ang / sbyin sreg gi bsrung 'khor grub nas thab kyi phyi'i gzhal yas khang bskyed chog dang / bgegs mthar byed la sreg rdzas phul nas bsrung ba'i phyir thab kyi kha khyer la byang shar du bzhugs tshar ba dang / thab nang gi me'i dbus su gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa bskyed pa sogs gsungs la rjes kyi bya bar/ 'das pa'i me lhar sreg rdzas phul tshar ba'i rjes su mchod bstod/ 'dod don gsol btab/ bzod gsol rnams bgyis te/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba ltar na/ thab nang gi lha rnams me tog gis mtshan pas spyan drangs te dkyil 'khor gyi lha gnas so sor bzhugs/ ma 'brel ba ltar na bsdu rgya sngags dang bcas pas rang gi lus kyi dkyil 'khor la bsdu zhing / gzhal yas khang bsdu ba'i gsal kha ma gsungs pas mi dmigs pa'i ngang du bzhag 'jig rten pa'i me lha lhag mas mchod pa sogs kyi rnam gzhag gsung la/ yang bsnyen pa'i kha bskong gi sbyin sreg la 'di ltar gsung ste/ sngags la mchog tu gzhol ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs nas sngags dang 'brel pa'i sbyin sreg khri phrag gcig gis lha tshim par bya dgos par bshad pas de'i tshul yang / bsnyen pa bya ba'i gnas de nyid du/ zhi ba'am rgyas pa'i thab khung rkyang pa byas la/ de'i drung du kha byang shar du bltas la/ sreg rdzas g.yas dang / mchod rdzas g.yon du bzhag rang rnam snang ngam rin 'byung gi gtso byas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs ting nge 'dzin gsum tshang bar bsgom nas/ mdun gyi sreg rdzas dang mchod rdzas rnams byin gyis brlabs/

thab khung bh+rūm̐ las gzhal yas khang du bskyed/ de'i nang du lhag mos ltar lha so gnyis rdzogs par bsgom nas/ nam mkha' la bteg de nas me blangs la sbar te/ mar blug la ma shi ba bya/ der sngar nam mkhar bteg pa de phab la/ bstod pa/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ mnyes mchod rnams sgrub thabs ltar bya/ de nas sngar zhi ba'i thab khung bris pa yin na/ lha so so'i sngags kyi mthar rdzas so so'i sngags dang / bdag gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa dang / rgyas pa'i thab khung bris na rim pa gnyis kyi rtogs pa dang yon tan thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes brjod/ bsdu na 'bru gsum gyi mthar zhi rgyas kyi spel tshig bcug pas rung ngo / /de ltar gsang sngags 'bum phrag re la/ sbyin sreg khri phrag re re bya'o/ /mthar dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod cing bstod/ dngos grub blangs/ nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ lha rnams rang gi lus dkyil la bsdu/ thab la ras gsar pas g.yogs la sba/ nang par yang cho ga la sngar bzhin 'jug go /yang na sbyin sreg dang bzlas pa dus mnyam du tshar bar bya ste/ sngags bcu bzlas shing sbyin bsreg re re byas pas/ sbyin sreg khri song tsam na sngags 'bum phrag gcig thon par bya ba'am/ yang na legs grub kyi rgyud las/ nyin par bzlas pa dang / de du song gi bcu cha'i sbyin sreg mtshan mo byed par bshad pas ji ltar rigs par nyams su blangs pas/ rang gi lhag pa'i lha mnyes par 'gyur zhing / rgyud des bsod nams rgyas shing / nyon mongs pa zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pas na rgyu mtshan de nyid kyi phyir bsnyen pa dang ma 'brel ba'i zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg la mi bskyod rdo rje'i dkyil chog dang 'brel na thab dkyil gyi gtso bo go 'pho mi dgos/ ma 'brel ba'i sbyin sreg yin na bdag bskyed mi bskyod pa'i sgrub thabs kyi byas nas/ sbyin sreg dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo zhi ba la rnam snang dang /

rgyas pa la rin 'byung du 'pho/ 'brel ma 'brel gang ltar na'ang thab kyi phyir bris pa'i gzhal yas khang bskyed chog dang / me'i dbus su gzhal yas khang le'u tshe dgu lha snam rim pa gsum gdan dang bcas pa bskyed/ bsnyen pa'i kha bskong gi sbyin sreg ltar na/ thab kyi phyir gzhal yas khang bri mi dgos par zhi rgyas kyi thab khung rkyang pa bris/ bdag bskyed la rnam snang ngam rin 'byung gang rung gi gtso byas pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom/ thab gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas par bskyed de mi bskyod rdo rje lha so gnyis bsgom pa'i rnam gzhag gsung zhing / de'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga yongs rdzogs dmigs bsal ma mdzad pa rnams gong du gsungs pa'i zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg sor bzhag byed pa ni rje rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs pa 'khrul med yin pas des na 'dir bsnyen pa'i kha bskong gi sbyin sreg bya ba la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ sa chog dgos pa dang mi dgos pa'i rnam dbye shes par byas pa'i sa phyogs su zhi ba'i thab khung brkos pa'am bris 'bur gang rung las/ phyag len la bris pa gtso che bas thab 'dri ba'i stegs dgos min skabs dang bstun pa'i gzhi la sa dkar dang ba byung dri bzang rnams kyis byugs/ thig chen brgyad btab pa'i mtho gang zlum bskor thab kyi dngos gzhi/ de'i phyir kha khyer dang mu ran sor bzhi pa res bskor/ de'i phyir stegs bu gru bzhi pa dang / de'i spang dang bri cha mdzes phyir cha ga sor do gru bzhi pa rnams btab pa'i thab kyi dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar zhi ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga/ phyogs bzhi'i 'dab mar 'khor lo/ rin chen/ pad ral bya ba'am/ yang na dbus su tshom bu sngon po phyogs bzhir dkar ser dmar ljang / yang na dbus dang phyogs bzhir nas 'bras gang rung gi tshom bu/ thab kyi kha khyer la rdo rje'i phreng ba/ stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje rnams bris pa'i thab la kha khyer gyi steng nas 'o ma can gyi shing /

srog chags med pa'i lci bas zlum po tho gang gi dpangs brtsigs la/ de'i nang 'jig rten pa'i shar lhor me tshang gi ting lo bzhag me lhar tshom bu dgos min gyi bshad pa med/ thab kyi phyir stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad dang shar nub gnyis su lhag re dang bcas pa'i phur gdan khung bu gru gsum pa bcu/ rang gi g.yas thab kyi g.yon nas gtsang ma'i stegs dang khud gang rung la 'o ma can gyi shing sbom phra mthe'u chung dang ring thung khru gang rtsa rtse mar dang sbrang rtsis byugs pa'i yam shing bcu cha'i grangs 'dzin sogs phon che ba dang / 'grub na kha tsha rul bsung med pa'i 'bri mar zhu ba'i khu ba/ de min mar khu gang rung / til/ zho/ 'o ma/ mar/ ka ra/ bur dkar/ sbrang dkar rnams tsam pa dang sbyar ba'i zas mchog 'bras/ so ba/ nas/ sran ma/ gro/ dur ba/ ku sha rnams kha gso'i chas dang bcas pa ting gtor steb sogs zhi ba'i snod gang rung du bshams pa dang / rang gi g.yon thab kyi g.yas su stegs dang ras sogs kyi gzhir 'bru bkram pa la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i zlum gtor bku bag can lnga'am/ gsum mam/ gcig me lha'i zlum gtor rnams bshams pa'i mdun chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang thab kyi shar 'jig rten pa'i nub tu rang gi stan nang tshang can de dang thab kyi bar du me yol dkar po gangs ri waṃ dang chu ris/ de'i rgyab stegs gang rung la rdor dril gyi bar du dgang blugs kha sbyar/ dung chos sogs snod gang rung du dri bzang gi chu 'thor yab bcas dang nang mchod 'thor nas gos gzung / bsrung 'khor gyi skabs su dgos pa'i phur pa bcu/ tho ba/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad/ spor lde rnams bsham mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang nyid gos rgyan dkar pos brgyan cing sdig sgrib sogs zhi bar 'dod pa'i bsam pas tsog pu'am skyil krung gang rung gi 'dug stangs kyis 'jig rten pa'i shar du kha phyogs par 'dug la/

rje rdo rje 'chang gi sbyin sreg las bsnyen pa'i kha bskong gi dngos bstan ltar na/ rnam snang gtso gyur gyi dkyil 'khor bsgom shes pa'am/ yang na shugs las bstan pa ni/ yig cha de nyid las/ zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg dkyil chog la sbyar rung bar gsungs pa dang / bdag bskyed tshogs rten nas nyer bsdu'i bar bzlas pa dang bcas pa rdzogs bar byas la zhes gsungs pas/ mi bskyod rje'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa byar rung bar gsungs pas na nged rang gis brtsam pa'i bsnyen yig mi bskyod dgongs rgyan du bshad pa'i gnas yo byin rlabs dang / bdag bskyed bsdus pa nyer bsdu'i bar byas la/ shu n+ya ta sogs dang / stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis pad zla'i steng du/ zhes pa nas 'od dmar po 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar bsrung 'khor gyi 'og bzhin/ de'i phrag pa nas rkang mthil gyi bar thams cad e las skyes pa'i sems dpa'i rdo rje dkar po de rnams las dus mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i yi ge hūm̐/ me'i 'od zer can dpag tu med pa 'phros te sa'i nyes pa thams cad bsregs/ rang gi snying kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ zhes sogs nas phyogs skyong bcu 'khor bcas kyi spyi bor zug par gyur bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ de nas steng la sogs pa'i phur pa rnams rim pa bzhin bzung zhing sgril la/ oṃ gha gha sogs kyi sngags brjod de btab par mos shing phur 'og tho bas brdung la rang ngam grogs gang rung gi gong du bshad pa'i phur gdan rnams la shar gyi g.yas nas bzung byang shar gyi bar dang / nub kyi g.yon rnams su btsugs/ de ltar na/ oṃ gha gha nas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa kyi bar lan bcu brjod la/ zhes snod mdzes la bka' bsgos pas nas/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ de nas ku sha'i chun po brgyad la bsangs chu 'thor yab kyis gtor/ oṃ āḥbigh+nan+ta kṛta sogs kyis bsangs/

oṃ shu n+yā ta sogs kyis sbyangs/ ngor chen gyi sbyin sreg las ku sha'i bskyed chog ma gsungs kyang / de'i bskyed chog tsam spyi 'gres kha bskang ba la nyes pa med pas/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa thab dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur zhes dang thal mo'i bar du bzung la/ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /tshangs pa yi ni dag byed de/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed yin/ /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /'dis bdag cag la bgegs med par mdzod cig oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li sarba bigh+nan nā sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa 'khyil pa'i sngags brjod cing / ku sha gtsang ma thab kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du g.yas bskor du dang po'i rtsa ba phyi ma'i rtse mos non pa dgram/ thab dang yo byad rnams la bsangs chu'i 'thor ba sogs gong bzhin bsangs sbyangs byas la/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab pad+ma dkar po zlum po rgyar khru gang gzabs su khru phyed/ kha khyer dang mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas mtshan pa/ phyi rol stegs bu gru bzhi ba'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes brgyan pa dang zhing thogs pa med pa bud shing brtsegs pa dang bcas par gyur/ mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas rnams a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams su aṃ las mchod yon zhes pa nas/ shaṃ las rol mo hūm̐ las sreg rdzas rnam par shes pa thogs pa med pa zhi ba'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs mchod pa byin rlabs bzhin dang / oṃ oṃ swāhā/ oṃ shrī swāhā/ oṃ dz+riṃ swāhā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ rtag tu bshad pa'i spor lde la bram ze rgyun bzhag gi me'am 'o ma can gyi shing rtsub pa las byung ba'am/ me shing las byung ba'i mes sbar ba thal mo'i bar du bzung ste/

oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum brjod cing thab la g.yas bskor byas la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐ phaṭa kyi me tshang gi ting lo sbar rtsa skam po gzhan dang mar gang blugs gsum gong gi dz+wa la'i sngags brjod cing blug pa dang rlung g.yab kyi g.yab pas me sbar/ bsangs sbyangs gong bzhin byas la/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las dus mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥraṃ hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las me lha gyur pa las me lha sā pa ka dkar po mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas na 'khor lo/ 'phreng ba mchog sbyin/ g.yon dril bu dbyu gu/ gan+dhe bsnams pa/ ral pa'i thor cog can/ sma ra dang ag tshom 'chang ba/ kriṣ+ṇa sa ra'i stod g.yogs can/ tshangs pa'i skud pa dkar pos mchod phyir thogs byas pa/ sku las bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun 'babs pa/ de'i spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma la āḥdamar po/ snying khar nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon po/ rang gi snying kha nas 'phros pa'i 'od kyis shar lho nas/ me lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang / lag pa g.yon pas g.yas pa'i mkhrig ma'am rtsa ba nas bzung / g.yas pas ku sha dang bcas pa'i mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ mthe bong bskyod nas/ mthe bong gi rtse mo srin lag gi rtsa bar 'dzugs bzhin pa'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che/ /lha'i drang srong bram ze mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'dir ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod/ /ces dang / oṃ ag+na ye/ ā dī bya ā dā+e bya/ ā bi sha ā bi sha mahā shrī ye/ ha pya ka pya/ bā hā nā ya swāhā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sā pa ka ag+ni ye/ ya man+ta kṛta dzaḥ zhes dang / lag pa gnyis khro bo'i khu tshur g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung la g.yas pa'i mdzub mo sbrel ba lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bya/

thab kyi me mtshams bzhugs par bsam/ pad+ma kā ma la ya stāṃ gyis gdan phul la/ ku shas bsangs gtor nas blangs pa gtor zhing / oṃ āḥbigh+nan+ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan kha yar brjod pas phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐ gi bar/ khu tshur rgyab sbyar ba zhags pa'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ āḥpradz+nyan+ta kṛta hūm̐/ khu tshur kha gyen bstan gyis mdzub mo gnyis dang / mthe'u chung gnyis sbrel ba lcags sgrog gi phyag rgya dang / oṃ āḥpad+mā ta kṛta baṃ/ g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyi steng du g.yon pa'i khu tshur brtsegs pa dril bu'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ āḥbigh+nan+ta kṛta hoḥ ces pas dam tshig pa la dbyer med du bstim/ de nas rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra a na la mahā bhū ta dz+wa la dz+wa la/ sarba bhasmi ku ru sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ tri sh+ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya stāṃ/ sa ma ya haṃ/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas dam la bzhag go /de bzhin gshegs pa'i khu tshur las mdzub mo gnyis brkyang bas dgang blugs bzung la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sā pa ka ag+ni ye mā ma shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ lan bdun gyi mar zhu phul ba'i mthar dgang blugs kha sbyar thab la g.yas su bskor zhing / a dī bya/ a dī bya/ a bhi sha a bhi sha mahā shrī/ ha pya ka pya/ bha ha na ya swāhā/ slar yang de 'dra ba lan gnyis te/ dgang blugs kyi mar 'bul ba bdun tshan gsum gyi byon zan phul/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me g+na sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du me tog nas rol mo'i bar dang rol chen bya/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum sbyar bas nang mchod mtheb srin gyis phul/ dril bu dkrol zhing / shes rab chen pos bdag med thugs chud cing / /thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba kun sgrol yang / /thabs la mkhas pas drang srong cha lugs ni/

/'dzin byed me lha khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad rab stsol ba/ /bdag gzhan don sbyor sa la bzhugs/ /tshangs sras mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod la sreg rdzas rnams dbul te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sā pa ka ag+na ye/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ye swāhā/ ma ma shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes dang / de bzhin du/ 'go'i oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sā pa sogs dang / mjug gi ma ma sogs kun la sbyar la bar gyi sngags so so ni oṃ ag+na ye swāhā/ mar/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya sarba pā paṃ da ha da ha swāhā/ til/ oṃ sarba sā pa de swāhā/ zan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swāhā/ 'bras/ oṃ badz+ra bi dza ye swāhā/ so ba/ oṃ mahā be ga ya swāhā/ nas/ oṃ mahā bā la ya swāhā/ sran ma/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri swa ri swāhā/ gro/ oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe swāhā/ dur ba/ oṃ badz+ra a pra ti ha ta swāhā/ ku sha rnams bdun re phul ba'i mthar/ mar dgang blugs bdun gsum dang / mchod bstod gong bzhin/ bsangs chu 'thor yab kyis gtor la/ oṃ āḥbigh+nan+ta krita hūm̐ phaṭa kyi me la bsangs gtor dang / bsangs chu'i snod de nyid dam/ yang na dri bzang gi chu'i snod gzhan lag tu thogs/ ting sogs snod gzhan zhig tu blugs la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ zhes dang / thab kyi drung du bzhag pas me lhar mchod yon phul te/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ zhes brjod/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa'o/ /de nas me lha bsangs chu'i bsangs sbyangs sogs gong bzhin dang / stong pa'i ngang las me'i dbus su pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ oṃ āḥbigh+nan+ta kṛta hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las bgegs mthar byed sngon po don grub kyi cod paṇa can sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ gtun shing / g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang / dril bu/ dgra satwa 'dzin pa/

sma ra dang smin ma zhes pa nas/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o zhes pa'i bar khro bcu bzhin la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bigh+nan+ta kṛta mā ma sarba bigh+nan nā sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdun gyi mthar/ a dī bya sogs sbyar ba lan gsum/ bsreg rdzas gzhan rnams kyi sngags kyang 'di kho na ste ku sha'i bar so so nas bdun re 'bul ba rdzogs nas/ hūm̐ bgegs mthar byed thab kyi dbang ldan mtshams su kha khyer la 'khod nas bar chad thams cad bsrung bar gyur/ 'dir ni bgegs mthar byed kyi mngon rtogs sgrub thabs bzhin bris la/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi sbyin sreg gi yi ger phyag mtshan mi 'dra bar gsungs kyang don la 'gal ba med dam snyam/ yang thab dang yo byad rnams la bsangs chu'i bsangs sbyangs gong bzhin dang / stong pa'i ngang las me 'bar ba'i dbus su chos kyi 'byung gnas zur gsum pa/ kha dog dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su yaṃ las nas/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng na g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis ye shes kyi 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du skad cig gis rdo rje 'chang sngon po zhes bsgyur/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung gong du drangs pa las thab khung gzhal yas khang du bskyed pa dang / de'i nang du lha bskyed nas nam mkhar bteg me sbar te slar nam mkha' nas sngar gyi gnas su spyan 'dren par gsungs pa ni cho ga bsdus pa 'das pa'i me lha rkyang pa mchod pa'i lugs su mdzad la/ 'dir thab khung bskyed pa sogs 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa'i rjes 'brel dang / me'i dbus su gzhal yas khang bsgom pa sogs ni rgyas pa'i lugs yin no/ /rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs la spos dang bcas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus 'gro ba'i rang bzhin mngon du mdzad/ /mi bzad bdud kyi dpung gis phyag byas pa/ /rang byung mtha' yas 'gro ba'i rang bzhin te/ /sems can snying po gcig gyur 'dir gshegs shig /ces pa dang / pad kor gyi phyag rgya bya zhing / oṃ e h+ya hi bha ga wan/ e hi bhak+ṣa/ sa ma ye/ na tsa/ pañtsa a mṛ ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha saṃ bhū dzaṃ pra sa dha ya mi/ zhes brjod pas mdun du byon pa la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra dhṛka mā ma shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes mar dgang blugs bdun phul ba'i mthar/ a dī bya sogs gong bzhin/ slar yang de 'dra tshar gnyis te mar dgang blugs bdun gsum gyis byon zan phul/ oṃ āḥya man+ta kṛta sogs dgug gzhug 'ching mnyes kyi sngags rgya gong bzhin/ lha thams cad kyi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma la āḥdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon po/ lha thams cad la rang rang gi rigs bdag yab yum kyi dbang bskur nas bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi sbyin sreg gi yi ger dbu rgyan rang chas can du bsam gsungs pa las gnas gsum byin rlabs dang dbang bskur ba ma gsungs kyang / lha sta gon dngos gzhi bum bskyed rnams la 'di bzhin yod pas rigs 'gre sbyar bar 'gal ba med dam snyam/ lha thams cad 'od dkar po 'phro zhing zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan pa'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar po babs pas sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzad cing ljags rnams la hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje dkar po lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī gu h+ya sa mā dza maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du me tog nas rol mo'i mthar rol chen/

oṃ āḥru pa badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes gzugs rdo rje ma dang / de bzhin du rū pa'i gnas su shap+tas sgra rdo rje/ gan+hes dri rdo rje/ ra sas ro rdo rje/ par+ṣ+yas reg bya rdo rje ma rnams kyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ oṃ swā āḥhā/ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khaṃ/ maiṃ/ thiṃlā/ oṃ oṃ oṃ hūm̐ oṃ paṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ nang mchod mtheb srin gyis dbul/ rig ma dang snyoms par zhugs pas mchog tu dga' ba'i bde ba chen pos rgyud gang bar gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing mkhyud rgya bya ste gsang mchod bya'o/ /rdo rje phyag 'tshal ba'i stangs ka dang dril bu sh+lau ka re'i mtshams su gsil zhing / mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /gsang ba'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med/ /rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog rdo rje nam mkha' 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /rdo rje'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod pa'i mchod pa'o/ /de nas yam shing bzung la/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka hūm̐ hūm̐ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ye swāhā/ mā ma shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ bcu gcig gis phul/ de bzhin du mar nas ku sha'i bar la'ang thog mar lha sngags bar du rdzas so so'i sngags mtha' mar sham bu'i sngags sbyar la so so nas bcu gcig re phul/

de nas spang par snod til bcas dang de bsog pa'i snod bzhag g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis til nas len zhing snod du blugs la/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes g.yon pas phreng bar grangs bzung la stong phrag gcig song ba dang / til thab tu phul/ yam shing nas ku sha'i bar la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ mā ma shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ kho na bzla zhing rdzas so so nas bcu gcig re phul/ 'di ni rje rdo rje 'chang gi sbyin sreg gi yi ge las/ bsdu na 'bru gsum gyi mthar zhi rgyas kyi spel tshig bcug pas kyang rung ngo zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa'o/ /tshul de ltar lan bcu'i 'bul tshan rdzogs pa dang / rgyas par na rnam snang nas snod mdzes kyi bar la lha sngags rdzas sngags/ bsham sngags rnams sbyar ba'i rdzas so so nas gsum re tsam 'bul ba'am/ bsdu na gtso bo la bcu cha phul ba des 'khor rnams la'ang go chod pa ni gsang sngags spyi 'gre bzhin no/ /de'i bar la me'i mtshan ma brtag ste/ 'ja' dang 'dra zhing mdog sdug dang / /byi ru bcag pa lta bu dang / /g.yas su 'khyil zhing shin tu bsnum/ /zhes sogs dge ba'i mtshan ma dang / de las ldog na mi dge ba'i mtshan mar shes par byas la/ oṃ āḥbigh+nan+ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa dang / bsangs chu gtor bas bgegs bsal/ mtshan ma bzang na de dag mi dgos so/ /rje rdo rje 'chang gi sbyin sreg gi yi ger gshegs skyems 'bul bar ma gsung kyang sbyin sreg gzhan ltar 'bul bar spro na byon zan bzhin no/ /yang rje rdo rje 'chang gi sbyin sreg gi yi ger/ de nas sngar bzhin mchod bstod byas la/ zhes gsung zhing / de'i go rim ni gong ltar yin zhing / yang yi ge de nyid las bsnyen pa'i kha bskong gi sbyin sreg skabs/ bstod pa/ phyi nang / gsang mchod rnams gsungs pas go rim cung zad mi 'dra yang / don la khyad cher med pas/ gsum pa de nas sbyin sreg gi lha la mchod pa sogs mjug gi bya ba rnams rim pa bzhin 'byung ba las/

mchod pa ni/ rang zhe sdang rdo rjer gsal ba'i lus gzhal yas khang du gyur pa'i nang du aṃ las mchod yon ma dkar mo/ zhes pa nas/ dkyil 'khor pa rnams la mchod par gyur gyi bar sgrub thabs bzhin dang / mchod pa rnams sngar ltar bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la zhes sogs gong ltar las dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ zhes so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs la/ lha yi mchod yon dam pa 'di/ /dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyid par 'tshal/ /thugs ni brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ /mgon po mchod pa 'di bzhis shig /oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra dhṛka ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ oṃ dzi na dzika ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du/ ar+ghaṃ man chad thams cad la sbyar ba'i/ oṃ swā rat+na dhṛka༞ oṃ āḥ.a ro l̥ka༞ oṃ hā pra dz+nyā dhṛka༞ oṃ laṃ mo ha rā ti༞ oṃ maṃ dwe ṣa ra ti༞ oṃ baṃ rā ga ra ti༞ oṃ taṃ badz+ra ra ti༞ oṃ raṃ rū pa badz+ri༞ oṃ shaṃ shap+ta badz+ri༞ oṃ gaṃ gan+dhaṃ badz+ri༞ oṃ raṃ ra sa badz+ri༞ oṃ khaṃ par+ṣe badz+ri༞ oṃ maṃ me tri༞ oṃ thiṃlā k+ṣi ti gar+bha༞ oṃ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi༞ oṃ oṃ kha ga༞ oṃ oṃ lo ke shwa ra༞ oṃ hūm̐ mañdzu shrī༞ oṃ oṃ sarba ṇi wa ra na biskaṃ bhi ni༞ oṃ paṃ sa man+ta bha dra༞ oṃ hūm̐ ya man+ta kṛta༞ oṃ hūm̐ pra dz+nyān+ta kṛta༞ oṃ hūm̐ pad+man+ta kṛta༞ oṃ hūm̐ bigh+nan+ta kṛta༞ oṃ hūm̐ ā tsa la༞ oṃ hūm̐ ṭak+ki rā dza༞ oṃ hūm̐ nī la daṇ+ḍa༞ oṃ hūm̐ mahā ba la༞ oṃ hūm̐ uṣ+ṇi ṣa tsakra warti༞ oṃ hūm̐ suṃ bha rā dza ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes pas mchod yon dang / chu skyes de bzhin thang las skyes/ /me tog dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /ci bde bar ni khyed kyis bzhes/ /oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra dhṛka puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā nas/ sum+bha rā dza'i bar ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su puṣ+paṃ bcug pa gong bzhin dang /

lhan cig skyes dang sbyar las byung / /de bzhin bdug spos mchog 'di dag /mchog tu༞ /ci bde bar ni༞ /puṣ+paṃ gyi gnas su dhū paṃ bcug la lha sngags tshang mas gong bzhin dbul/ zhun mar 'bru mar mar me 'di/ /lha rdzas 'bar bas mun pa 'joms/ /mi shes thams cad zhi bya'i phyir/ /bdag nyid dad pas 'bul bar bgyi/ /dhū paṃ gyi gnas su dī paṃ sogs gong bzhin/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi/ /dri mchog dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu༞ /ci bde bar ni༞ /dī paṃ gyi gnas su gan+dhaṃ sogs gong bzhin/ bza' dang bca' ba yang dag ldan/ /kha dog dri dang ro ldan zhing / /thams cad sbyar ba'i zhal zas 'di/ /'bul gyis yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /gan+dhaṃ gyi gnas su/ nai wi d+ya sogs gong bzhin/ sil snyan la sogs rol mo'i tshogs/ /dbyangs kyi nga ro ldan pa 'di/ /mchog tu༞ /ci bde bar ni༞ /nai wi d+yaṃ gyi gnas su shap+ta sogs gong bzhin lha sngags tshang mas phul/ dharma ra ṇi dang rol chen bya/ de nas 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa ni/ rin chen dbang gi rgyal po bai ḍūr+ya/ /sngon po la sogs kha dog dbyibs kyi gzugs/ /rnam gsum gzugs kyi rdo rje mar byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi spyan la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ āḥrū pa badz+ri hūm̐/ ma zin 'byung ba'i tshogs pa las byung ba'i/ /sbyor bral dbyangs la sogs pa sgra yi tshogs/ /rnam gsum sgra yi rdo rje mar byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi snyan la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ āḥshap+ta badz+ri hūm̐ dang rol chen/ ga bur a kar dza ti la sogs pa/ /legs par sbyar ba'i byug pa dri yi tshogs/ /rnam gsum dri yi rdo rje mar byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi shangs la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ āḥgan+dhe badz+ri hūm̐/ lus mchog brtas byed bdud rtsi'i zas la sogs/ /dngar skyur kha dang bska la sogs pa'i ro/ /rnam gsum ro yi rdo rje mar byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi ljags la dbul bar bgyi/

/oṃ āḥrā sa badz+ri hūm̐/ lus la reg pa tsam gyis bde ster ba/ /dpag bsam gos la sogs pa reg bya'i tshogs/ /rnam gsum reg bya rdo rje mar byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi lus la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ āḥpar+ṣe badz+ri hūm̐ dang gos bzung phul/ de nas rgyal srid sna bdun gyi mchod pa ni/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la sogs sngags dang bcas pa yongs grags dang / nye ba'i rin chen bdun gyi mchod pa ni/ g.yul las rgyal bar byed pa'i ral gri dang / /tsha grang gnod pa skyob pa'i pags pa dang / /yang 'jam nyon mongs med pa'i mal cha dang / /dga' mgu rtse bar byed pa'i yid 'ong tshal/ /gang 'dod lta nus bde bar nyal ba'i khyim/ /thags bzang bsregs bcad mi nus 'jam pa'i gos/ /chu la mi 'jing ngal dub med pa'i l+h+wam/ /nye ba'i rin chen sna bdun 'di dag gis/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams khams kyi mtha' gtugs pa/ /bkang ste bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /oṃ sap+ta u pa rat+na pūts+tshi ti āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya'o/ /nang bdud rtsi'i mchod pa ni/ byin rlabs sgrub thabs ltar byas la 'bru gsum tshar gcig nang mchod nas mtheb srin g.yon pas blangs te gtor ba'i rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa'i thod pa bdud rtsi'i gang bas mchod par bsam zhing / ngag tu/ gtor snod kyi 'og tu mi gsung bar 'og tu yaṃ las zhes pa gsung rgyun yin/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gnyis/ oṃ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje mdzad pa'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang gang la thob pa'i mtshan brjod pa yin no/ /de nas/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ in+d+ra bhu ti/ klu las byung ba'i ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/

rgyal po bi su kalpa/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen/ grub chen klu'i byang chub/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa/ slob pa'i rdo rje/ slob dpon nag po spyod pa/ sa 'dres pa chen po/ paṇa chen bir+ya bha dra/ de ba a ka ra tsan+d+ra/ dī paṃ ka ra/ 'gos lo tsā ba/ dbus pa dge ser/ bla ma gnam kha'u pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ gnam kha'u pa rdo rje bdud 'joms/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal ba/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ paṇa chen dbang phyug grub pa/ 'jam dbyangs ngag gi dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog lhun grub/ sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen/ 'dren mchog dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis/ bla ma dkon mchog rgyal po/ bdag gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang seng ge rgyal mtshan rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag gnang / chos kyi 'brel pa thob pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyas par na lha sngags tshang ma'i mthar 'bru gsum btegs pa'am/

bsdu na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ oṃ swā āḥhā/ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khaṃ maṃ thiṃlā/ oṃ oṃ/ oṃ hūm̐/ oṃ paṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ces pa bsdus pa 'di don tshang bas legs so/ /gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de nas mtheb srin gyi rang gi lce rtse/ smin mtshams/ spyi gtsug rnams su thig le byas te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas lus dkyil gyi lha tshim par bsam/ bar phud kyi gtor ma rnams sbyangs/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ye/ mahā kā li de wi ye/ dharma pā la tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra/ rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gdong bzhi pa sogs dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyogs skyong bcu/ lha chen brgyad/ klu chen brgyad/ 'jigs byed dgu/ rgyal chen bzhi/ gza' chen dgu/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa 'jig rten skyong ba chen po rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ brjed byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong / pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bod khams skyong bar byed pa'i bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dang / gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag yul bdag dkor bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad tshim zhing zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas/ myur du bla na med pa rdzogs pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsang mchod ni/ rig ma dang snyoms par zhugs pas mchog tu dga' ba'i bde ba chen pos rgyud gang bar gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā nu ra ga ṇa badz+ra swā bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing 'khyud rgya byas pa'i rkyen gyis lha tshogs thams cad snyoms par zhugs pas mchog tu dga' ba'i bde bas thugs rgyud tshim par bsam mo/ /de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che sogs/ de ltar de nyid lnga pas bstod/ de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma rnams bigh+nan gyis bsangs/ shu n+yā tas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor snod kyi 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du a las byung ba'i thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du/ pad+ma dmar po as mtshan pa'i shar du/ gau las ba lang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las rta yi sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha shar lhor bi las dri chen/ lho nub tu raṃ las rak+ta/ nub byang du shu las byang sems/ byang shar du ma las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ dbus su mu las dri chu/ de thams cad la oṃ yig gis mtshan pa/ de rnams kyi steng gi bar snang la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos me sbar bas rdzas rnams bzhu zhing bskol te 'bar bar gyur/ steng gi zla ba rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung nas dkrugs shing / de nyid 'dres pas ma dag pa'i dri ma thams cad sbyangs dag pa'i shel ltar gyur/ pad+ma aḥdang bcas pa las 'od 'phros dri ma med par byas nas nyi ma'i mdog can gyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du rtogs/ oṃ las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kha nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas 'og gi bdud rtsi la thim pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dpag tu med par spel zhing sbar bar gyur/

kyai rdor bde mchog sogs la'ang gtor ma byin rlabs sogs su mi mdzad pa ha ho hrīḥmadzad/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur pa'i rwa dbus ma la oṃ gyis mtshan pa de'i 'od zer gyis gtor ma gsol bar bsam la/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ nas/ oṃ āḥsum+bha rā dza pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐/ zhes pa'i bar lha sngags tshang ma lan gsum gyis 'bul/ mchod yon dang rol mo bzhag pa'i oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ sogs nyer spyod lnga dang bdud rtsi'i mchod pa gong bzhin gyis mchod la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas mi bskyod rdo rje sogs de nyid lngas bstod/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /nas/ 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye/ /zhes pa'i bar yongs grags kyis bden pa'i stobs brjod/ rdo rje gsum dngos mi phyed sku/ /ye shes lnga ldan bde ba che/ /'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pa'i bar yongs grags kyi 'phrin las bcol/ de nas kyai rdor sogs yi dam kyi lha dang / sgos kyi chos skyong rnams dang / mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dgos na phul la 'jig rten pa la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ ā ā+oṃ gtor snod kyi shar du skad cig gis dbang po ser skya glang po che la gnas pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang / g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he la gnas pa/ g.yas dbyug pa dang / g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ nub tu chu lha dkar po chu srin la gnas pa phyag gnyis kyis sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ byang du lus ngan ser po gter la gnas pa g.yas bi dza pu ra ga dang / g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa/ mer me lha dmar po ra skyes la gnas pa g.yas bgrang phreng dang /

g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ bden bral du srin po nag po ro langs la gnas pa g.yas ral gri dang / g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ rlung du rlung lha dud kha ri dwags la gnas pa phyag gnyis kyi rlung ras 'dzin pa/ dbang ldan du dbang ldan dkar po glang la gnas pa g.yas rtse gsum dang / g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ steng du tshangs pa ser po ngang pa la gnas pa zhal bzhi pa phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na spyi blugs dang mi 'jigs pa/ g.yon gnyis na dbyug pa dang bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ 'og tu sa'i lha mo ser mo pad+ma la gnas pa/ g.yas dpang por khas len pa/ g.yon bum pa 'dzin pa/ de rnams kyi mtha' bskor du lha klu/ gnod sbyin/ dri za/ lha ma yin/ nam mkha' lding / mi'am ci/ lto 'phye chen po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ brjed byed/ rnon po la sogs pa srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ de rnams skad cig gis stong pa nyid du gyur pa las dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i skur gyur/ gtor mgron rnams kyis gong bzhin du gtor ma gsol bar bsam la/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/ oṃ da sha dika a bas+d+yi te bh+yaḥ sogs/ nged rang gis brtsams pa'i bsnyen yig bzhin lan gsum gyis dbul/ de nas/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe/ dhu paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐/ oṃ dā sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi phul la rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ oṃ phyogs bcu rnam par gnas rnams dang / /zhes sogs bsnyen yig bzhin brjod nas 'phrin las gzhol la/ gzhi bdag gtor ma sogs 'bul ba rnams phyag len rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar nas dbul/ mchod pa kha gsos la bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs byas te mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i phyi mchod dang rdo rje ma lnga/ nang mchod/ gsang mchod bstod pa rnams gong bzhin bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/

zhes brjod/ yig brgya lan gsum dang / ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyi mthar/ gang yang bdag cag las dang po pa'i sogs rgyun bzhin nongs bshags dang / rten yod na phyogs bcu na sogs brtan bzhugs bya/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi sbyin sreg gi yi ge las/ thab nang gi lha rnams bsdu rgya sngags dang bcas pas rang gi lus la bsdu bar gsungs pas de bzhin nam/ rgyas par na/ rdul tshon gshegs gsol skabs kyi bsdu tshul 'di bzhin byas kyang mi 'gal bas/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas thab nang gi lha rnams la phog pas lha rnams spyan drangs/ rang gi phung po lnga la rgyal ba rigs lnga/ khams bzhi la yum bzhi/ mig sogs la sems dpa' sems ma/ tshigs chen bcu la khro bo bcu/ lus kyi cha shas so so la rten gyi dkyil 'khor rnams thim pas rang nyid lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhe sdang rdo rje yab yum du gyur te/ de dag yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer 'phros te sems can thams cad la dbang bskur nas sgrib pa dag nas hūm̐ yig du gyur pa des nam mkha'i khams gang ba yongs su gyur pa las sems can thams cad rdo rje 'chang du gyur/ de rnams rang gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyis spyan drangs nas rang nyid la thim/ zhes brjod/ rang lugs gur lha brgyad dang zhal gyi rten med na gshegs gsol mi rung bas gong du de dag la gtor bsngo byas tshe lha brgyad dang zhal rang gi lus la bsdu/ rang nyid kyi dad rten sku thang lta bu yod na de la brtan bzhugs bya/ rten la ma brten pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams/ oṃ khyed kyis sogs gtor mgron gzhan rnams la gshegs gsol/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐ phaṭa/ mar dgang blugs gang phul la/ me lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du gyur/ mchod bstod dang bsreg rdzas gong bzhin phul ba'i mthar/ mar dgang blugs bdun gsum phul ba'i mthar/

mchod pa gong bzhin dang / bstod pa ni/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ṭak+kis dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gi nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ces pa'am/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su skyabs pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis skur sprul pa/ /rigs sngags grub pa'i drang srong mchog /nyon mongs bsreg pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyis sprul pa'i theg pa chibs/ /rig sngags gsung gi bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan gun+dhe bsnams/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la gsol/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che/ /de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /ces pas bstod la/ me lha'i gtor ma byin rlabs rgyas par na gong bzhin nam bsdu na bsangs sbyangs gong bzhin dang / stong pa'i ngang las gtor snod thod par gyur pa'i nang du gtor rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ/ zhes brjod/ rdor thal kha phye'i mthar se gol gtogs la mtshan sngags la a ka ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas nai wa d+ya āḥhūm̐ gi bar/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha/ /drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhes sogs kyis 'phrin las bcol/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang la/ rang gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /bsgrub byed bsreg bya za ba gshegs/

/ji bzhin dus su tshur byon zhing / /bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrub/ /oṃ badz+ra muḥ thal mo rgyab sbyar ba'i mtheb srin gyis se gol gtogs/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /sangs rgyas kun gyi kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang thob gyur cig /'gro bas kyang ni de thob shog /byang chub phyir ni spyod gang dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyang gang yin dang / /byang chub rdo rjes gang gsungs pa'i/ /spyod de gnyis ka'ang bdag spyod shog /ces pas bsngo ba dang / bkra shis rgyas bsdus ci rigs bya/ de nas me ma shi bar du mi dkrug mi gdal/ mi 'gom/ long med na zhi ba la 'o ma dang / rgyas pa la dri ser pos me gzhil la/ thal ba dang sol ba rnams bsdus nas las thams cad pa'i bum par blug la rgya mtshor 'babs pa'i chu klung du dor te/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /tshul de lta bus tshugs nyin cho ga tshar gcig de'i sang tshar gnyis/ grol nyin tshar gcig byas pas gtso sngags bzhi khri 'gro ba ste bsnyen pa bzhi 'bum gyi dbang du byas la bsnyen pa chig 'bul yin na sbyin sreg chig khri'i kha bskong bar 'gyur bas cho ga tshar gcig gis chog go /zhes dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs mi bskyod rdo rje lha so gnyis kyi bsnyen pa'i kha skong gi sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'di yang 'grel chen sgron gsal dang / rab 'jigs rdo rjes mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg gi yi ge'i gsal byed/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'phrin las rgya mtsho bzhin la/ las sgrub pa dang / bsnyen pa'i kha skong gi sbyin sreg gnyis kyi dbye ba so sor shin tu nges par byas shing / de'i gsal byed gang dgos/ 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus 'phags lugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'phrin las mkha' khyab nas kha bskang ste sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la dpal sa skya'i zur 'chad pa ban tshang dbu mdzad chos rje rin chen rgyal mtshan nas rtsom zhes bskul ba bzhin sbyar ba'o/
